name: Sausage, Mushroom & Ricotta Pita Bread "Calzones" with Dressed Greens

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 205°C (400°F). Line two baking sheet pans with parchment paper.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Use the tip of a knife to slice down the length of the sausages. Peel off the casings and discard. Add sausage meat to the skillet and break apart with a spoon until crumbly. Cook, stirring often, until browned and almost cooked through, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and roughly chop mushrooms. Add to the skillet and cook, stirring often, until mushrooms are soft and sausage is cooked through, 4-5 minutes more.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the skillet along with tomato sauce and spices; stir to combine and remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1 ½ (213 ml) cans tomato sauce
¾ tsp Italian seasoning
¼ tsp salt
3 pinch crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Cut pitas in half and carefully open them.
Spread a layer of ricotta cheese inside the bottom half of each pita. Layer with sausage mixture and grated cheese. Divide filled pitas between baking sheets, placing them ricotta-side facing down.
Place calzones in the oven and bake until the outside is crisp and the inside is hot and bubbly, 7-9 minutes.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, and spices in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper
3 pinch Italian seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the lettuce. Chop or tear into bite-sized pieces and transfer to the bowl with the dressing. Toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide calzones and salad between plates and enjoy!
